statements.subject: push_notification
statements.description: scheme: HTTP Authentication Scheme from the IANA registry. Examples: Bearer, Basic, Digest. Scheme names are case-insensitive per RFC 9110 Section 11.1.

statements.subject: push_notification
statements.description: credentials: Push Notification credentials. Format depends on the scheme (e.g., token for Bearer).

statements.subject: push_notification
statements.description: The webhook payload is a StreamResponse object containing exactly one of the following: task: A Task object with the current task state; message: A Message object containing a message response; statusUpdate: A TaskStatusUpdateEvent indicating a status change; artifactUpdate: A TaskArtifactUpdateEvent indicating artifact updates
statements.guard_semantics: exactly one of allowed_values must be present in StreamResponse webhook payload; becomes NuXMV INVAR not a per-transition guard

statements.subject: push_notification
statements.description: When a task update occurs, the agent sends an HTTP POST request to the configured webhook URL. The payload uses the same StreamResponse format as streaming operations. The agent MUST include authentication credentials in the request headers as specified in the PushNotificationConfig.authentication field.
statements.post_cond: http_post.sent = true & http_post.authorization_header_present = true & http_post.body.type = StreamResponse
actions: Agent sends HTTP POST request to configured webhook URL
Agent includes Authorization header with authentication scheme and credentials from PushNotificationConfig.authentication
Agent sets Content-Type header to application/json
Agent includes StreamResponse object as the request body

statements.subject: push_notification
statements.description: Clients MUST respond with HTTP 2xx status codes to acknowledge successful receipt. Clients MUST validate the task ID matches an expected task. Clients SHOULD process notifications idempotently, as duplicate deliveries may occur.
actions: Client validates that task ID in payload matches an expected task
Client responds with HTTP 2xx status code to acknowledge receipt

statements.subject: push_notification
statements.description: Agents MUST attempt delivery at least once for each configured webhook. Agents MAY implement retry logic with exponential backoff for failed deliveries. Agents MAY stop attempting delivery after a configured number of consecutive failures.
actions: Agent optionally retries with exponential backoff
Agent optionally stops delivery after configured consecutive failure threshold is reached
